name: Morinaga Hana
source:
The Heroine.

A third-year high school student. Hana is a very quiet girl that likes to keep to herself.

At first, she is very reluctant to join in all the chaos associated with Valentine's Day. But she is the type of person who cannot ever say "no," especially not towards her good friend, Riko.

Although, Hana is not at all interested or experienced with dealing with boys or relationships.

Like Touma she is a part of the school library committee, since reading is one of her favourite pastimes.

Despite being an avid-reader she is a bit of an airhead.

[From [url=http://twinproject.weebly.com/chocolate-cage.html]Twin Project[/url]]
